fieldValues.title: Memory measurements are taken but do not steer the system
fieldValues.statement: srs-context hooks log which records each session reads and writes, and the bench measures speed, retrieval, cost and freshness, but nothing turns those numbers into a change: no one watches the stats on a schedule, the usage hook records no timings, and the dream reads the counts without a rule that acts on them (on 2026-10-29, 139 of 210 records had never been read). An agent cannot learn which parts of the memory pay for themselves.
source_ref: srs-context hooks/usage-log.py (ids and op only, no duration)
